subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should no-override subagent/cron sessions preserve current `bootstrap-extra-files` allowlist behavior, or should hook extras require explicit `bootstrapTier: "full"` after this PR?
rationale: The code issue is clear, but the permanent default and upgrade behavior change the public agent bootstrap/context contract.

options.title: Preserve Defaults Before Merge
options.body: Keep existing no-override hook-extra behavior and limit hook-source exclusion to explicit `minimal` and `standard` tier choices before merge.

options.title: Accept Root-Only Legacy
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally require `bootstrapTier: "full"` for hook extras in subagent/cron contexts, but the PR needs explicit docs and upgrade proof.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Bootstrap Design
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want one selector contract for tiering and related context controls.

recommendation.title: Preserve Defaults Before Merge
recommendation.body: Keep existing no-override hook-extra behavior and limit hook-source exclusion to explicit `minimal` and `standard` tier choices before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The original subagent bootstrap filtering history makes this the best available owner for the config/default decision.
